## Summary

Closed **UMR-03** on FChecklist/compliance-tracker: **PR #460**, TIER2, awaiting Owner sign-off.

- Registered the claim in `ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml` (no duplicate found beforehand) as its own first commit.
- New `compliance.instruction_execution_cache` table (`drizzle/0242`) + `src/lib/services/instruction-execution-cache-service.ts` (`findPriorExecutionPath`/`recordExecutionPath`), reusing `embeddings.ts`'s `generateEmbedding()` and `assistant-memory-service.ts`'s RLS-respecting `sql``+db.execute()` pattern — not a new bypass connection.
- Wired into the one real chat/DMP dispatch entry point, `fde-service.ts::submitFdeRequest`: checks the cache before the embedding-over-capabilities search, records a resolution after an embedding match, an LLM-assisted match, or a new Worker Agent proposal. UI (`/fde` page, VeriComposer.tsx, pill rendering) untouched.
- Added `ai-os/registry/asset-registry-coverage.yaml` exemption for the new table.
- 10 new tests; `bunx tsc --noEmit`, `bun run lint`, `bun test` (1698 pass/0 fail) all clean; all 6 local CI guardrail scripts pass.
- Posted structured `AUDIT: PASS` PR comment (had to fix formatting once — the validator requires plain `Label: value` lines, not markdown bold — then retriggered CI).
- All required CI checks green (Lint, Type Check, Build, Unit Tests, E2E Tests, Asset Registry Coverage, Guardrail Presence, audit-check); only the known-rate-limited, non-required Vercel check failed.

**Not merged** — this diff touches `drizzle/0242_umr03_instruction_execution_cache.sql` and `src/lib/db/schema.ts`, so per this task's own tiering rule it's TIER2 and needs your sign-off before merge: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/460
